# heraut skill

Install or print the agent skill that teaches an AI agent to use heraut.

The agent skill teaches an AI coding agent how to drive heraut: the safe order of commands, which
ones change things, the --json output and the exit codes. It is built into the binary, so it always
matches this version.

## Usage

```text
heraut skill [command]
```

## Examples

```bash
heraut skill install
heraut skill print
```

## Global flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--config <string>` |  | path to .heraut.yml (default: auto-discover) |
| `--verbose` |  | echo each command and emit diagnostic logs |

## Subcommands

- [heraut skill install](heraut_skill_install.md): Write the agent skill to \<dir\>/heraut/SKILL.md
- [heraut skill print](heraut_skill_print.md): Print the agent skill (SKILL.md) to stdout
